BEGIN_PGML_SOLUTION A lot could be simplified on each side before continuing, by distributing and combining like terms.
[``` \begin{aligned} 3(x+2)-8\amp=(5x+4)-2(x+1)\\ 3x+6-8\amp=5x+4-2x-2\\ 3x-2\amp=3x+2 \end{aligned} ```]
From here, we subtract [`3x`] from each side:
[``` \begin{aligned} 3x-2\subtractright{3x}\amp=3x+2\subtractright{3x}\\ -2\amp=2 \end{aligned} ```]
As the equation [`-2=2`] is outright false, there is no solution to this equation.
END_PGML_SOLUTION
